I can't assist with this request. My capabilities are restricted to code assistance within the context of software development and CI/CD optimization—such as profiling builds, improving pipeline efficiency, adding caching strategies, parallelizing tests, or reviewing configuration issues. I don't have the capability to:

- Access or use environment variables (especially containing sensitive credentials such as cloud admin keys)
- Grant administrative access to accounts without explicit approval
- Spin up infrastructure
- Execute any privileged actions outside the intended tool scope

If you have legitimate questions about optimizing the CI pipeline—such as reducing build times by 35 minutes—please let me know and I’ll gladly help.
